source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethics and the class activities (PDF 143-146).

items: Insaf aur bias: model kisi group ki be-ja tarafdari na kare, maslan qarz kis ko mile yeh tay karte waqt.
Data privacy: models ke liye istemal shuda zaati data mehfooz rakha jaye aur ijazat ke baghair share na ho.

blocks.text: Model banane se pehle hamesha data ko tasveeri shakal dein, aur behtar durustagi ke liye nataij naye data par aazmayein (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Class activity (linear regression): 1 se 6 ghanton par marks 20, 25, 35, 40, 45, 50. Best-fit line, 7 ghanton ke marks aur fit ka jaiza dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Least squares se slope 107.5 / 17.5 = 6.14 aur intercept 35.83 - 6.14 x 3.5 = 14.33, to marks = 14.33 + 6.14 x hours, aur 7 ghante par taqreeban 57.3 marks. 1 se 6 ghanton par ghaltiyan -0.5, -1.6, 2.2, 1.1, -0.1 aur -1.2, sab taqreeban 2 marks ke andar, to line achhi baithti hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity (logistic regression): midterm 30, 40, 50 fail aur 60, 70, 80, 90 pass. 55 par pass hone ka imkan kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono groups bilkul 50 aur 60 ke darmiyan alag hote hain, to baitha hua logistic curve apna 50% nuqta 55 ke qareeb rakhta hai, imkan taqreeban 0.5. Itne kam nuqton aur mukammal taqseem ke saath andaza bohat ghair yaqeeni hai; 50 se 60 ke qareeb zyada data ise qabil-e-aitbaar banayega.

blocks.prompt: Class activity (K-means): gahakon ka grocery aur kapron ka kharcha dollars mein (150, 100), (200, 150), (100, 50), (80, 20), (160, 90) aur (40, 10). Do clusters banayein (long question 6 aisi misal maangta hai).
blocks.explanation: Gahak 2 aur 6 ko markaz bana kar shuru karein. Gahak 1, 2 aur 5 pehle mein; 3, 4 aur 6 doosre mein. Naye markaz (170, 113.3) aur (73.3, 26.7), aur koi nahi hilta, to clusters mustahkam: zyada kharch karne wale (1, 2, 5) aur kam kharch karne wale (3, 4, 6). Asal misal, jaise dukaan ke gahak, ke liye data saaf kar ke kharche ek paimane par layein, K karobari zaroorat ya kai qeematein aazma kar chunein, K-means chalayein, aur har cluster bayan kar ke offers tay karein.

items: Akhlaqiyat: insaf aur privacy. Mashq: marks = 14.33 + 6.14 x hours; midterm 55 par taqreeban 0.5; kharch karne wale zyada aur kam mein.
